summary: H.B. Fuller Company filed an 8-K disclosing the pricing of $850 million aggregate principal amount of 7.625% senior unsecured notes due 2034, at an issue price of 100% of principal, in a Rule 144A/Regulation S private placement expected to close on or about October 21, 2026. Proceeds, together with available cash and other borrowings, are earmarked to fund the purchase price for the acquisition of Advanced Medical Solutions Group plc, to repay credit agreement borrowings, and to repay or redeem its 4.000% notes due February 15, 2027, plus general corporate purposes. The excerpt omits acquisition price, premium and closing date; watch deal financing conditions and regulatory approval timing.
